newsitem.title: UK: Elisabeth Murdoch takes on BSkyB programming.
newsitem.headline: Elisabeth Murdoch takes on BSkyB programming.

text.p: Elisabeth Murdoch, daughter of media tycoon Rupert Murdoch, is taking charge of all programming at British Sky Broadcasting Group, the company said.
The move is part of the satellite and cable television broadcaster's strategy to meet the demands of the digital era.
BSkyB said in a statement on Tuesday that Murdoch, the general manager of broadcasting at Sky Television, would work with James Baker, who has been appointed head of programming.
Baker joins the group from UK satellite and cable service Nickelodeon International, where he was responsible for creating new Nickelodeon channels in Germany, Australia, Latin America.
